name: 196cc 6.5 Hp (Honda GX200 Clone) Ignition Coil for the Baja Mini Bike MB165 & MB200 (Baja Heat, Mini Baja, Baja Warrior)
description: Ignition coil for all versions of the 196cc 6.5 Hp Baja Mini Bike, including the MB165 and the newer MB200 models. The Baja Mini Bike is also known as the Baja Heat, Mini Baja, and the Baja Warrior. This coil is compatible with most 196cc 6.5 Hp Honda style GX200 clone engines.
